units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 5:18">Targ. I Kings V, 18</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="Q00089"><he>פְּגָעִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:28">Ruth R. to I, 16</cite> (ref. to <he>אל תפגעי</he> <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:28">ib.</cite>, as if it were <he>תִּפָּגְעִי</he>) <he>לא תחטא עלי לא תסבין פ׳ מני</he> (not <he>פגעיך</he>) do not commit a sin through me, do not suffer afflictions on my account (by dissuading me from embracing the Jewish faith).

senses.gloss: pl. evil spirits. Targ. II Esth. I, 2.
